nodes.description: Ether raised counter tracked in LottoToken; incremented in BuyTicket and decremented in withdraw.
Payable wallet address that receives withdrawn Ether; set in constructor and changeWallet.
Minimum ETH required to buy a ticket; increased by 0.00001 ether on every BuyTicket call.
Minimum token amount required for ExchangeTicket; 'MinExchangeAmount.add(1)' result is discarded.
Upper bound (1000) used to modulo the pseudo-random value.
Team reserve address receiving initial mint and game-end mint.
Nested mapping of gameId => account => balance, mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Mapping gameId => total supply, mutated by _mint and _burn.
Current game identifier used to key balances, allowances and supply; incremented by _incraseGameId.
Contract owner checked by the onlyOwner modifier used by changeWallet and withdraw.
Constructor: sets teamReserve and wallet, mints 999,000,000 tokens to the contract and 1,000,000 to teamReserve.
Payable external entry point: requires msg.value >= MinBuyAmount, accumulates weiRaised, transfers a pseudo-random token amount to the caller and raises MinBuyAmount.
Public entry point: burns MinExchangeAmount tokens from the caller and transfers a pseudo-random token amount from the contract.
Private view returning keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty) % MaxRand + 1 scaled by 10**18; predictable randomness.
Internal game-end hook: if keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty) % 10000 == 1 it increments _gameId and mints new tokens.
onlyOwner function updating the payout wallet address.
onlyOwner function that decrements weiRaised and forwards Ether to wallet using a low-level call.
Internal token transfer updating _balances for the current gameId and emitting Transfer.
Internal mint increasing _totalSupply and _balances, used by constructor and _gameEndCheck.
Internal burn decreasing _balances and _totalSupply, used by ExchangeTicket.
Internal helper incrementing _gameId via SafeMath.add; result of the add is assigned to the state variable.
Caller-controlled address used as ticket buyer, exchanger and token recipient.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as a randomness seed in random() and _gameEndCheck().
Low-level external call wallet.call{value: amount}("") forwarding Ether before any reentrancy guard exists.
Pseudo-randomness derived from block.timestamp and block.difficulty, fully predictable/influenceable.
Unbounded increase of MinBuyAmount (MinBuyAmount + 0.00001 ether) affecting ticket price; MinExchangeAmount.add(1) result is discarded.
Constructor parameter _wallet assigning the payout wallet.
Constructor parameter _teamReserve assigning the reserve address.
Parameter of changeWallet, the new payout address.
Parameter of withdraw, the ETH amount forwarded to wallet.
Local variable in BuyTicket holding the pseudo-random token amount emitted and transferred.
Local boolean capturing the success flag of the low-level Ether call in withdraw.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is hashed together with block.difficulty to produce the random token amount, making randomness miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp participates in the game-end condition keccak256(timestamp, difficulty) % 10000 == 1, allowing timestamp manipulation to trigger mints.
msg.sender is used as the ticket buyer and recipient inside BuyTicket.
msg.sender is used as the exchanger whose balance is burned and credited in ExchangeTicket.
random() result is used as the transferred amount in BuyTicket.
random() result is used as the transferred amount in ExchangeTicket.
MaxRand bounds the modulo applied to the pseudo-random hash in random().
BuyTicket calls _transfer to move tokens from the contract to the buyer.
BuyTicket invokes _gameEndCheck after each ticket purchase.
BuyTicket increases MinBuyAmount by 0.00001 ether on every purchase without bound.
BuyTicket adds msg.value to weiRaised via SafeMath.add.
ExchangeTicket burns MinExchangeAmount tokens from the caller via _burn.
ExchangeTicket invokes _gameEndCheck after each exchange.
MinExchangeAmount.add(1) is computed but the result is never assigned, so the exchange threshold never changes.
The unsafe timestamp-derived randomness operation is realized by random(), the source of all payout amounts.
withdraw performs a low-level value call to wallet after updating weiRaised, with no reentrancy guard.
withdraw forwards the requested Ether to the wallet state variable address.
withdraw subtracts the payout amount from weiRaised using SafeMath.sub.
withdraw is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which reads _owner.
changeWallet is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which reads _owner.
changeWallet overwrites the wallet state variable with _newWallet.
_gameEndCheck increments the _gameId state variable when the game ends.
_gameEndCheck mints new tokens to the contract and to teamReserve via _mint.
_incraseGameId assigns _gameId.add(1) back to the _gameId state variable.
_mint increases _totalSupply for the current gameId.
_burn decreases _totalSupply for the current gameId.
_transfer subtracts from the sender balance and adds to the recipient balance in _balances.
Constructor mints the initial token supply via _mint.
Constructor assigns the teamReserve state variable.
Constructor assigns the wallet state variable.
Constructor parameter _wallet flows into the wallet state variable.
Constructor parameter _teamReserve flows into the teamReserve state variable.
changeWallet parameter _newWallet flows into the wallet state variable.
withdraw parameter amount is subtracted from weiRaised and forwarded as call value.
Local rand holds the payout amount used by BuyTicket for both the event and the transfer.
Local sent captures the success flag of the external Ether call in withdraw.
The low-level call to wallet can re-enter withdraw (or other guarded entry points) before completion.
BuyTicket pays from the contract's own balance in _balances for the current gameId.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _wallet is directly assigned to the wallet state variable inside the constructor, so it can be folded into the constructor core node.
Constructor parameter _teamReserve is directly assigned to the teamReserve state variable inside the constructor, so it can be folded into the constructor core node.
_newWallet is only used to set the wallet state variable inside changeWallet and has no independent identity.
amount is a direct input to the weiRaised subtraction and the low-level value call within withdraw.
rand is a short-lived local holding the random() payout amount within BuyTicket only.
sent is a short-lived local holding the success flag of the external call within withdraw only.
